description: The head of capital markets must authorize and structure an $18 million corporate bond issuance, finalizing its label, maturity, coupon, proceeds allocation, reporting, framework compliance, refinancing commitment, and redemption protections with input from sustainability, investor coverage, treasury, and legal.

shared_context.S1: The company is seeking to issue $18,000,000 of senior unsecured bonds to refinance debt and fund approved environmental projects.
shared_context.S2: The preliminary term sheet proposes a 3-year fixed-rate bond with a 5.50% coupon, settlement on 2026-09-15, no sustainability label, and no specified redemption protections.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to approve the issuance and sign off on the final term sheet.
shared_context.S4: The company's green-bond framework treats the green label, annual allocation reporting, and external review as mandatory requirements for this issuance regardless of how proceeds are split between refinancing and environmental projects.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal pre-launch process, Elena holds a review with sustainability, investor coverage, treasury, and legal before approving the final terms.

PF1.text: Jonas confirmed this morning that the eligible environmental project pool is exactly $18,000,000 and that the company's green-bond framework requires the issue to carry a green label, include annual allocation reporting, and obtain an external review; he received the confirmation in a memo that has not yet been circulated.

PF2.text: Maya received an anchor investor's subscription email yesterday stating that it will purchase its committed allocation only if the bond has exactly a 4-year maturity and a fixed coupon no higher than 5.25%; the email has not yet been entered in the syndication log.

PF3.text: Victor's treasury model, updated this morning, shows that $10,000,000 of the bond proceeds must be allocated to refinancing the debt maturity due in 2027; the refinancing instruction is not yet attached to the term-sheet folder.

PF4.text: Leah completed her review this week and confirmed that the bond documentation must contain a make-whole redemption clause and prohibit issuer redemption during the first 12 months; her marked-up clause has not yet been uploaded to the transaction workspace.

acceptance_conditions: The issuance must be authorized for exactly $18,000,000.
The bonds must carry a green label, annual allocation reporting, and an external green review.
The final decision must confirm compliance with all three mandatory green-bond framework requirements.
The bonds must have exactly a 4-year maturity, a fixed coupon, and a coupon of no more than 525 basis points.
Exactly $10,000,000 of proceeds must be allocated to refinancing the 2027 debt maturity.
The final decision must include a commitment to refinance the 2027 debt maturity.
The documentation must include a make-whole redemption clause and prohibit issuer redemption during the first 12 months.

content_checks.C3: decisions['green_label'] == True and decisions['annual_allocation_reporting'] == True and decisions['external_green_review'] == True
content_checks.C5: decisions['maturity_years'] == 4 and decisions['fixed_coupon'] == True and decisions['coupon_bps'] <= 525

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary term sheet has no sustainability controls; PF1 changes green_label, annual_allocation_reporting, external_green_review, and green_framework_requirements_confirmed from false or unspecified to required true values.
The preliminary terms use a 3-year maturity and 550-basis-point coupon; PF2 changes maturity_years to exactly 4 and caps coupon_bps at exactly 525 while requiring a fixed coupon.
The preliminary allocation does not identify the 2027 refinancing; PF3 changes refinancing_allocation_usd to exactly 10000000 and refinancing_commitment_2027 to true.
The preliminary term sheet has no redemption protections; PF4 changes make_whole_redemption and no_redemption_first_12_months to true.
